title: Texas Senate margin of victory
rules: If the Democratic Party wins the 2026 U.S. Senate election in Texas by 1 percentage points or more, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Michigan Senate margin of victory
rules: If the Democratic Party wins the 2026 U.S. Senate election in Michigan by 1 percentage points or more, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Maine Senate Exact Outcome
rules: If ALL of the following occur for before Jan 2027: Dem Nominee: Graham Platner, General Election Winner: Democrat, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Maine-Texas Senate Combo
rules: If ALL of the following occur: Texas Senate: James Talarico wins, Maine Senate: Susan Collins wins, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will Democrats sweep the "core four" Senate races?
rules: If Democrats win the 2026 Senate elections in ALL of the following states: Georgia, Michigan, North Carolina, AND Maine, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Bluest state to elect a Republican senator in 2026?
rules: If Massachusetts is the state with the highest 2024 Harris-minus-Trump presidential margin among states where a Republican candidate wins a 2026 U.S. Senate election, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: How low will Trump's approval rating get before 2027?
rules: If Donald Trump's approval rating during Dec 11, 2025 to Dec 31, 2026 as reported by VoteHub is below 38%, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: How much will the US acquire Greenland for?
rules: If the Total Monetary Consideration for a U.S. Acquisition of Greenland is exactly $0 / No Acquisition during Trump's term, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: 2028 Republican VP nominee
rules: If J.D. Vance accepts the nomination for the Vice Presidency for the Republican party in 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Who will run for the Democratic presidential nomination in 2028?
rules: If Cory Booker announces a presidential campaign to contest the presidential nomination of the Democratic party for the 2028 U.S. presidential election before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: 2028 Presidential matchup
rules: If Gavin Newsom (D) and JD Vance (R) are the nominees for the 2028 presidential election, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: 2028: Who will win the Presidency, House, and Senate?
rules: If the Democratic party wins the House, the Democratic party wins the Senate, and the Democratic party wins the Presidency in the 2028 election, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Donald Trump announces departure as President? (Excluding death)
rules: If Donald Trump leaves office before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will President Trump be impeached during his term?
rules: If the President of the United States has been impeached before Jan 20, 2029, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will Trump be impeached and removed from office?
rules: If the President of the United States has been impeached and convicted by the U.S. Senate before Jan 20, 2029, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Who will be the next Supreme Court justice?
rules: If Amul Thapar is the first person confirmed by the Senate to the position of Justice of the Supreme Court by January 20, 2029, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Who will Trump pardon?
rules: If Robin Smith has been given a presidential pardon, commutation, or reprieve during Trump's second term and before Jan 21, 2029, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Who will be charged with a federal crime in 2026?
rules: If Letitia James has been formally charged with a federal crime  after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the US take control of any part of Greenland?

title: What will be the 51st state in Trump's term?

title: When will traffic at the Strait of Hormuz return to normal?

title: Will the Citrini scenario happen?
rules:
If at least 3 of: 
unemployment rate exceeds 10% (monthly BLS)
S&P 500 declines more than 30% from its closing level on Issuance
Zillow Home Value Index declines more than 10% YoY in any of: NYC, LA, San Francisco, Chicago, Houston, Phoenix
labor share of gross domestic income (GDI) first-release value for any quarter falls below 50%
CPI-U (All items, not seasonally-adjusted) YoY falls below 0% in any monthly release

occur in any release published after Issuance and before July 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
